events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Theme Tune
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred... it's James Bond Day! Which iconic 007 theme tune gets your vote as the absolute best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86, born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. What's the one song that truly captures his spirit for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Favourite Cleese Moment
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Favourites
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'! Which track from this sprawling masterpiece is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the irreplaceable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Impact
angles.copy: 35 years on, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's the one Queen song that always reminds you of his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing a new direction for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Favourites
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! A pivotal album for the Fab Four – what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate. What's the song of his that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today, born in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie's influence is still felt everywhere. What's your favourite era or persona from his incredible career?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935.

angles.name: The King's Enduring Reign
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to Elvis Presley! The King's music still gets us all shook up. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, born in 1944.

angles.name: Page's Riffs
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of so many iconic riffs. Which Led Zeppelin track showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Happy 82nd birthday to the distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, born in 1945.

angles.name: Rod's Raspy Voice
angles.copy: Raise a glass! Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today. From rock anthems to classic croons, what's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, born in 1961.

angles.name: Madness with Suggs
angles.copy: One Step Beyond... into another year! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite nutty sound from him?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, born in 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young's Hits
angles.copy: Wherever I Lay My Hat, that's his birthday! Happy 71st to Paul Young. Which of his smooth hits always gets you singing along?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81

angles.name: Dolly's Timeless Charm
angles.copy: It's Dolly Parton's 81st birthday! From 'Jolene' to Dollywood, her charm is timeless. What's your favourite Dolly moment or song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and successful songwriter, Gary Barlow, born in 1971.

angles.name: Gary's Best Ballad

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
